decision.summary: Confirmed temporary offset in N/E from index 489 to 524: multi-sample onset, sustained low plateau, no return within context. A subsequent abrupt upward jump at 525–530 lacks a clear return by 579, so classified as uncertain. U remains stable throughout, supporting cross-axis coherence of the offset. No evidence of permanent step coexisting inside the confirmed interval; the jump at 525 may be part of an incomplete return or separate event.

intervals.observation: N and E show a multi-sample drop starting ~490, reaching a sustained low plateau (N ~ -2 to -4, E ~ -2 to -3) through index 524; U remains stable. The onset is gradual over ~5 samples (489–494), interior is flat for ~30 samples, and no return observed before 525.

A sharp upward jump in N and E occurs at 525–530 (multi-sample, >3σ on both axes), but no clear opposing return is observed within allowed_context (up to 579); values remain elevated or noisy afterward. U shows no matching step. Return ambiguous/unobserved → uncertain.
